data.title: Jay-Jay Okocha Where Is He Now? The Bolton Hero So Good They Named Him Twice - The False 9
data.content: * Man City News Today: Haaland Doubt, Semenyo Out and Squad Knocks (20 October). * Liverpool News Today: Szoboszlai and Frimpong Out, Iraola on Perez, Munoz Praised (20 October). Jay-Jay Okocha beat Oliver Kahn, joined Bolton on a free and became the Reebok's favourite. On 21 January 2004, Jay-Jay Okocha scored a direct free-kick in the second minute and another in the 80th as Bolton beat Aston Villa 5-2 at the Reebok in the first leg of a League Cup semi-final. That’s the Okocha this piece is about: the Bolton cult hero, the man Sam Allardyce called “so good they named him twice” when he picked his best Premier League XI for premierleague.com in 2016. First, how a free transfer from Paris Saint-Germain became the most entertaining player at the Reebok. The first half was in Germany, on 31 August 1993, when Okocha was 20 and playing for Eintracht Frankfurt against Karlsruher SC.
